project.name: airness-parent
project.description:
The parent a consuming project inherits. It carries the plugin configuration and the lifecycle bindings, so a consumer states its coordinates and its dependencies and receives the harness.
It currently binds the three static analyzers. The rest of the harness (coverage, mutation analysis, Error Prone, the governance drivers) is added here as each is externalized, and a consumer picks it up by raising one parent version.

requireUpperBoundDeps.message: A transitive dependency is down-versioned by another path. Pin it explicitly rather than leaving the resolution order to decide.
